title: 郭凯隔夜利率低于七天：别当宽松信号，转向框架只待宣布
speaker: Guo Kai

segments.en: I think this is a move that has been in the train for several years. Yes.
segments.zh: 我认为这是一个已经酝酿数年的举措。是的。

segments.en: PBOC is trying to control the fluctuation of overnight rate, and they made it very clear they want to move to overnight rate, like just in federal reserve, you know, typically.
segments.zh: 央行试图控制隔夜利率的波动，并明确表示希望转向隔夜利率，就像美联储通常所做的那样。

segments.en: I think we shouldn't read too much into the significance of the overnight rate being lower than seven-day rate. Okay. I think that's not the intention.
segments.zh: 我认为我们不应过度解读隔夜利率低于七天利率的意义。好的。我认为那不是意图。

segments.en: The intention is really to move to the most active part of the founding market, and to regulate that market, and let the overnight rate eventually translate, transmit to other parts of the yield curve.
segments.zh: 真正的意图是转向资金市场最活跃的部分，并调节该市场，让隔夜利率最终传导至收益率曲线的其他部分。

segments.en: So it shouldn't be necessarily read as a de facto slight easing? No, I don't read that way.
segments.zh: 所以不应必然解读为事实上的小幅宽松？不，我不这么看。

segments.en: I think if you look at in the past several years, PBOC is really trying to move to the overnight rate. They're doing all kinds of preparations, like narrowing the interest to corridor, minimize the fluctuation of the overnight rate.
segments.zh: 我认为如果你回顾过去几年，央行确实在努力转向隔夜利率。他们做了各种准备，比如收窄利率走廊，尽量减少隔夜利率的波动。

segments.en: I think they are now almost ready to shift from seven-day to overnight. Like this year, you would say?
segments.zh: 我认为他们现在几乎准备好从七天转向隔夜。比如今年，你会这么说吗？

segments.en: That part I'm not entirely sure, but you know, the factor I think they are already moved towards overnight rate. It's really just waiting for announcement.
segments.zh: 那部分我不完全确定，但你知道，我认为他们已经在向隔夜利率靠拢。真的只是等待宣布。
